p='ledgerly/adjustments.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('from .invoice import invoice_total\n','from . import audit\nfrom .clock import ensure_utc\nfrom .errors import BillingError\nfrom .invoice import invoice_total\nfrom .money import ZERO, round_money\n')
s=s.replace('''def outage_refund(payment, amount, at):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage."""
    raise NotImplementedError
''','''APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("1000.00")


def outage_refund(payment, amount, at, *, idempotency_key=None, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage."""
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("outage_refund"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > round_money(payment.amount):
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and not approved_by:
        raise BillingError("approval_required", str(amount))

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= round_money(payment.amount):
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "outage_refund",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        at=at,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python -m pytest -q"}
